query: Consult: 70-year-old woman admitted for lower GI bleeding. For women 65–75 with lower GI bleed within first 72 hours, what is the 25th percentile lab instability score? Compare critical lab-event frequency with general inpatients and report cohort LOS and mortality.
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY l.value) AS instability_score, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.value < -1 THEN l.subject_id END) AS critical_events, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.value < -1 THEN l.subject_id END) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) FROM w70), 0) AS critical_ratio, (SELECT AVG(los) FROM icustays WHERE subject_id IN (SELECT subject_id FROM w65_75)) AS avg_los, (SELECT AVG(dod) FROM patients WHERE subject_id IN (SELECT subject_id FROM w65_75)) AS avg_mortality FROM labevents l WHERE l.subject_id IN (SELECT subject_id FROM w65_75);
